## About

FNO Localization accompanies the study of resolution-invariant microseismic source localization with a Fourier neural operator [@abdullin2025fno]. The model learns to map seismic observations to event locations and is demonstrated on field data from the Utah Frontier Observatory for Research in Geothermal Energy (FORGE).

## Why it matters

Conventional localization repeatedly solves wave-travel-time problems and can be expensive in operational monitoring. A trained neural operator is evaluated with one forward pass, making it attractive for rapid decisions during geothermal or subsurface operations.

## Key result and audience

The public record reports accurate hypocenter estimates in complex velocity settings and with partial data coverage. The repository is intended for researchers in induced seismicity, geothermal monitoring, neural operators, and real-time geophysical inference.
